headline: Student edition - Malagueña Suite (modified for piano) played by Yinuo, Liu

rights.credit: Isaac Albéniz (1860-1909), composer File: Jason M. C., Han

recording_credit: Isaac Albéniz (1860-1909), composer File: Jason M. C., Han
recording_description: This sound image was recorded for a little girl student - Yinuo, Liu in my real piano classroom. It was made for the educational purpose, which can be seen as a teaching & learning result from myself, of piano Malagueñas (flamenco style) (Wikipedia introduction: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Malagueñas_(flamenco_style) ) from Isaac Albeniz (Wikipedia introduction: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Isaac_Albéniz ) and from many elements of Wikiversity Portal:Maloguena dream ( https://en.wikiversity.org/wiki/Portal:Maloguena_dream ) designed by myself (Wikiversity Website: https://en.wikiversity.org/w/index.php?title=File%3AMaloguena_dream.ogg ), inputted into the local piano-curriculum of student YInuo, Liu's, totally for her musical practices, progress and growth. Yinuo, Liu (Name's meaning is: A promise made by the family Liu to...) is a only little Chinese girl piano learner in her 11th year. After we found her genres in learning & playing Spanish music and strong dancing rhythmic sense (She has a dancing background of learning), it's a time for us to choose a fashion for this little girl student's dream and development. Then, we found this piece - Malagueña Suite (modified for piano) in China's National Grade Test Teaching-book. To be very honest, it's a completely new area for both my student and me to explore and understand Spanish music (such as flamenco: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Flamenco ; Cante jondo: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cante_jondo ; Andalusian folk music ; and Sir Albeniz's fashion - such as one impression ' less musical science, less of the grand idea, but more color, sunlight, flavor of olives...; and nothing with their turns and shapes, but which are like the air, like the sun, like the blackbirds or like the nightingales of its gardens...' ). In order to enlighten her the enthusiastic fashion of Spanish music, the relaxable beach waves and sunshine, the profound singing of Cante jondo... I have searched many information from online, and especially from Wikipedia articles. You knew, I have an educational thought or to say, dream - for students, we need to find some true things, beautiful impressions, and emotional heart-touches from history and from the real life... So that, we began to take this hard job in hands' ability-training, the flexibility of scenery transformation, musical imagination and theme-reasoning... The girl student has also shown her great perseverance in accompanying bass, special understandings of melodic lines, wonderful dreams of Spanish life, and up-dating progresses across sessions and across cultures. Finally, after a local competition's training and exercising (She almost got some confirms from local practices by her performances), when we began to record her classroom edition, you knew, how excited we felt we are doing... It's to say, we are put our musical dreams out to share with more international people, which would include this music's hometown... You may have a pair of critical ears in finding... left hand's bass sometimes was so strong and noise; some short parts, especially connections, would be not quite smooth; or the middle beach-taste was a little bit too slow and needed some much tender waves ... Oh, friends, she was only a 11 years' old girl student who needed a space of development to her sky... All in all, though some points needed to be better, I think it's a successful case of piano education that we - both the tutor and the student really got many benifits from the learning of Spanish music and the Malagueña dream from many impressions of Sir Isaac Albéniz.

headline: KV279 2nd Movement Shading Andante hollowed-out by Sunlights
creator: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart

rights.label: CC BY-SA 4.0 (source-declared)

recording_description: ( Notice : For 'some researching Comments and information corrections of 1774 - Transcendentalism', please see the 8th point of Wikiversity Portal:Mozart's Genius Techniques in Kids' Eye [1] . The 3rd version was in my current technical sophistication near the perfection in my classroom which was played in much more Mozart's original purposes, but the 1st version was always my favorite one.) This sound file was an expressive edition of Mozart's KV279 (1784) - 2nd movement Andante recorded from my own classroom (self-studio). It is one of my most favorites. Regarding with more information, please refer to Wikipedia introduction ( Piano Sonata No. 1 (Mozart) ) Depending on my knowledge and musicality, I would point out several importances for my understandings: 1. 1784 was a year Mozart had met Haydn, which could have impacted Mozart's style of Classical countermelody and its application in his second 'tender' movement, especially from the communication with Haydn and his Baroque exploration in 1782 - 1783. 2. It's said this movement was 'full of expressive shading, the result of Mozart's harmonic freedom'. Yes, it's quite right. However, this 'harmonic freedom', in my mind, was from a sudden tiredness (or to say, a 'lazy happiness) after so many happy events broken into Mozart life without the time to relax... In the manuscript, Mozart have all recorded his emotional senses after those mental & real 'adventures' & 'legends' of heroism he made. 3. Masonic music style could also give Mozart some inspirations, as a Freemason's. 4. Imagining: On one morning you woke up under some heavenly golden sunlight and with a lazy stretch, what would you feel? Soul has almost been hollowed-out by those lights directly, which made you feel the world in your life wasn't quite true and was as if in your dream as almost in heaven... Under the sunshine, is it still a little bit of shading sadness hidden back by your sensitive brain... regarding with the position or dream, indeed, you have never changed and reached, though many achievements gained on the way...? Oh, at that moment, you don't want to think more... just let a slow tune going... going into the golden sunlight, as if time has already terminated besides, and with a small true 'your self' hidden in a dark square around your standing feet... Enough or not enough? Oh, God's child - Mozart... what have you really seen before this work? Finally, thanks to the original manuscript from Breitkopf & Hartel Company and the University of the Arts Berlin, which allow me to touch Mozart's original thoughts of ornamentations and dynamics in his works and more - some extra emotions, for on-going 'Across Time'. Based on a classical respect and a personal love, thanks to the usage of Tokfo/Vienna Gallery! Jason M. C., Han ( talk ) 14:25, 28 August 2018 (UTC)

headline: Turkey March for Mozart and Memory JMC, Han
creator: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart

rights.label: CC BY-SA 4.0 (source-declared)
rights.basis: Recording licence from the linked Wikimedia Commons file record.

recording_description: This sound file was a classroom-edition recorded during my self-practising time. It was as a remembrance of Sir Mozart in my heart and in my childhood (as a little piano learner's). To be honest, the smartness of my hands and its sound effect in that time were much better than this current one, especially in some linking and transiting parts. I feared about the lost that one day I couldn't play it out again in that speed and especially in that emotional youth-heart. Its production was from the demands of my teaching in classroom. However, I am dreaming: someday, I could use it to tell how Sir Mozart's techniques in my little heart and for students' hands-training after many other pieces could be recorded out. Oh, so many memories in terms of it merged from the bottom of my heart-sea, especially one attendance of APEC branch-conference in Yantai- sorry, I forgot its time -(Wikipedia introduction: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yantai ) that one hundred pianos were playing this piece together outdoor facing blue sea and sky, and I was a member among many little boys and girls in which I used to be so excellent and proud of myself. Then, alongside my age's growth, I played it to many people in other places including tutors, peers, and even some kind persons in the communities of UK by a digital piano... Oh, afterwards, my students needed me and it again, and I decided to teach it as my own piano tutor did but with many new ideas about its background and why some techniques should be like... I didn't know whether or not it was successful. After listening to Romuald Greiss', with many respects in my hearts, (Wikimedia commons: https://commons.wikimedia.org/w/index.php?title=File%3AMozart-Marsz_turecki-(Romuald_Greiss).ogg ) I found it wasn't so bad as I had thought, as a direct classroom edition, especially about the part - 'darkness progressing octave'. It was really hard and easily broken for both pianists and teachers, though before it, Romuald Greiss had used 'ritard. - A tempo' to save his energy and overcome it...still several notes...^-^ I thought: if possible, a better edition, after another many practices, would come soon, which we can expect... Thanks for your listening! Thanks for the usage of 'Tokfo/Vienna' gallery!

recording_description: This version is a life rough data-collection for the exposition of piano techniques. To be honest, the existing of it is in a little bit far distance from my art dream, but as in respects of Sir Debussy's impressionist universe. It is based on my current energy, time and ability. If possible, I would like to soon modify this draft to further better ones. In that dreaming pure 'snow-land', the paint-brush, transformed by hands and threaded by forces from mechanics and anti-mechanics, can magically draw lights, clouds, bubbles and steam to be the colourful Spaces &Times of a mirrored universe. Then, Chou Chou can freely and naughtily play her games forever. If the final bang is a waking-up sound breaking Chou Chou's beautiful sleep. I would rather we never come back to the reality from this childish dream. Third version was preferred as my best version till currently, with full energy and happy emotional senses like a doctorial kid carrying the curiosity in piano pedagogical researching, though currently my hands wouldn't realize a similar one... Hopefully, you like it. I would like to give it as a best wish to 2017 Christmas Day.
